title: Natural number encoded by a bit string
statement: For a finite Boolean string $s$, define its encoded natural number by starting with $1$ and reading the bits of $s$ from right to left, replacing the current value $m$ by $2m+1$ for a true bit and by $2m$ for a false bit.
